CLEC International Chinese Language Teachers Scholarship: official application entry

name.en: International Chinese Language Teachers Scholarship at Tongji — March2027 semester
name.zh: 同济大学国际中文教师奖学金（2027年3月一学期研修）

summary.en: Tongji funds tuition, standard accommodation, CNY2500/month living allowance and CNY400/person semester comprehensive medical insurance for March–July2027 study (five-month funding). The university normally provides a free twin room according to actual dormitory availability. Only if no campus room is available, and after student application and Tongji approval, off-campus support of CNY700/month is paid monthly or quarterly; it is not unlimited rent reimbursement. Students first buy insurance after arriving in China; the school reimburses the specified amount to the student’s bank account the following month. Both central and Tongji applications are required by 25 October2026, with no school application fee. The linked HTTPS CLEC entry has an Apply action; the current Tongji brochure separately lists its university application system as http://study-info.tongji.edu.cn. A verified HTTPS replacement for that mandatory school system has not been established, so follow the official brochure’s instructions or contact iss@tongji.edu.cn. The published benefits do not promise unspecified travel/visa reimbursements; payment and cancellation conditions apply.
summary.zh: 2027年3月至7月学习，资助五个月，包含学费、标准住宿、每月人民币2500元生活费及每人每学期400元综合医疗保险。学校原则上按实际房源提供免费双人间；仅校内无房，经本人申请和同济批准后，可按每月700元、按月或季度领取校外住宿补助，不是无限额报销房租。保险须学生来华后先自行购买，次月按规定报销至学生银行账户。须在2026年10月25日前完成中央及同济两套申请，学校免报名费。本条链接为有“我要申请”按钮的语合中心HTTPS入口；当年同济简章另列学校系统http://study-info.tongji.edu.cn，尚未建立其HTTPS替代入口的核验证据，请按官网说明办理或联系iss@tongji.edu.cn。未承诺未列明的交通、签证等报销，生活费核发及取消条件适用。

eligibility.en: For new applicants to Tongji’s one-semester, non-degree Chinese Language and Literature scholarship route, entering March2027 and completing July2027; funding lasts five months. This is an admission award, not an enrolled-students-only prize; selection is competitive and an award is not guaranteed.
eligibility.zh: 面向申请同济大学2027年3月入学、2027年7月结业的一学期非学历汉语言文学奖学金项目新申请者，资助五个月。属于入学资助，并非仅在读生评优，择优评审且不保证获奖。

eligibility.en: Non-Chinese citizen; friendly to China with no criminal record; comply with Chinese law and university rules; good physical/mental health, academic and behavioral standing; interested in Chinese language education/teaching and related work. A recommending institution is required at application.
eligibility.zh: 须为非中国籍人士，对华友好、无违法犯罪记录，遵守中国法律和校规，身心健康、品学兼优，有志于从事中文教育、教学及相关工作；申请时须有推荐机构。

eligibility.en: Age18–35 on 1 September2026; the limit extends to45 for in-service Chinese teachers. Tongji’s university-specific lower age is18.
eligibility.zh: 以2026年9月1日计算，年龄18–35周岁，在职中文教师可放宽至45周岁；同济本校规定最低18岁。

eligibility.en: The semester Chinese Language and Literature direction requires HSK Level3 at least180 and an HSKK score report, within their two-year validity. Applicants whose passports contain X1 or X2 visa records are not admitted to this semester route.
eligibility.zh: 一学期汉语言文学方向要求HSK三级至少180分并具有HSKK成绩，成绩在两年有效期内；护照上有X1或X2签证者不予录取。

eligibility.en: The university application window is 25 September–25 October2026. Complete both the CLEC scholarship application and Tongji’s international-student online application before the school deadline. The school application fee is waived. The central October31 deadline does not extend Tongji’s earlier October25 deadline.
eligibility.zh: 本校申请期为2026年9月25日至10月25日；须在校方截止前同时完成语合中心奖学金申请及同济大学国际学生在线申请，免报名费。中央10月31日截止不延长同济10月25日的本校截止。

eligibility.en: All semester applicants submit: passport photo-page scan; valid HSK/HSKK report scans; a recommending institution head’s signed recommendation scan; and a medical certificate within six months or a valid Chinese visa page. Master’s-only materials in the brochure are not requirements for this non-degree semester award. Tongji may request supplements; upload all required documents and bring originals at registration. Falsified materials cancel admission.
eligibility.zh: 一学期申请者均提交：护照照片页扫描件、有效HSK/HSKK成绩扫描件、推荐机构负责人签名推荐信扫描件，以及六个月内体检证明或有效在华签证页。简章中硕士专属材料不套用于本条非学历奖学金。同济可要求补件，网申上传全部材料，报到携带原件备查；材料造假取消入学资格。

eligibility.en: In-service Chinese teachers supply employer proof and a recommendation for equal-conditions priority; Chinese Bridge scholarship-certificate holders apply with their award certificate under the official procedure. Register as required in the admission notice; failed medical examination, withdrawal, unauthorized late registration or suspension cancels eligibility.
eligibility.zh: 在职中文教师提供任职证明及单位推荐信可获同等条件优先；汉语桥奖学金证书获得者凭证书按官方流程申请。须依录取通知书报到，体检不合格、中途退学、未经许可不按时报到或休学等将取消资格。

eligibility.en: Living allowance is full for registration by the15th inclusive and half for later registration. Personal absence from China exceeding15 days outside winter/summer holidays suspends the allowance during the absence; suspension, withdrawal or disciplinary action stops payment from the corresponding date. Payment for completers runs to half a month after the university-confirmed completion date.
eligibility.zh: 15日及以前报到当月发全额生活费，此后报到发半月；非寒暑假因私离华超过15天，停发离华期间生活费；休学、退学或处分自相应日期停发，结业者生活费发至学校确定结业日期后半个月。
